text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha!! It encroaches upon even the 
sun... Darkness runs rampant now...!

Tanino Gimlet came to give her morning 
greeting. I had heard she got a new 
outfit, but—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hah! A moment of tranquility... Look upon 
the truth with eyes cloaked in silence.

Prompted by Tanino Gimlet, I took a calm 
look at the dress... and it turned out to 
be styled that way intentionally.

Upon asking for more details, it turned 
out Tanino Gimlet had torn up a secondhand 
dress she prepared and customized it this 
way herself.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Fitting, wouldn't you say?

Asked succinctly, I nod and say it suits 
her well. Still... why go out of her way 
to tear it?
choice_data_list: Did you not like the original design?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Surely you understand, Trainer. The 
shimmering remnants beyond the dark— The 
true value born from destruction!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. What an innocent, childlike face. 
In that case, follow me. I shall guide you 
to the answer.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"A garden of flowers crafted by humans in 
an attempt to captivate the goddess of 
love and beauty..."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Blooming obediently in vibrant colors, as 
if following a preordained destiny...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what do you think, seeing me 
stand here?

Just like before, I wonder if she's asking 
if it looks good on her.

Tanino Gimlet and flowers. There's no 
reason why the combination shouldn't fit. 
...Yet, if asked whether it matches her 
image, well—

Just as I was about to answer, a gust of 
wind blew. Standing amidst a storm of 
swirling petals and tangled colors, Tanino 
Gimlet was—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. It seems there's no need to ask.

The quietly resting flowers were 
beautiful, too. But seeing the silence 
shatter as petals danced wildly in the 
air—it felt like a brand-new world was 
opening up before me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I always harbor an impulse named 
destruction. An uncontrollable urge, just 
as exiled wings proclaim their desires.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yet it is also a liberation. Shattering 
the world inside the framed painting, and 
building a new world upon the broken 
glass—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Crafting, building, creating! That is!! 
The one and only world that belongs to me!

Tanino Gimlet didn't tear it up simply 
because she disliked the design.

"Destruction is merely a process of 
creation. She's saying that the old 
clothes were a fitting seed to birth a new 
world." ...Or something like that, 
probably.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, so you understand. Then you, 
too, should take hold of it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha! Together, let us destroy this 
world! And create a new one!!

"It turned out to be the vintage shop 
where Tanino Gimlet had bought the dress. 
The moment the owner saw me, he smirked 
and set aside a whole outfit for me."

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
An outfit worthy of Tanino Gimlet's 
Trainer... is just one step away. Now, 
give it everything you've got!!

It seems she already understands 
everything quite well. She snorts proudly, 
asserting that her remake preparations are 
flawless. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Fuhahahahaha!! That's my Trainer for you!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Charge toward the ferocious beast's roar! 
Carve open a path where there is none!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Come, more, give me more! Scream, destroy, 
create...! A new world... mine, ours, 
yours!!

The clothes were splendidly torn and 
restyled by the store manager. Seeing the 
finished product, Tanino Gimlet gave a 
deeply satisfied laugh.

"I gave it my all, but tearing off a big 
piece was difficult. So instead, I tried 
tearing off little bits here and there."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ho... creating many doors, are we? Though 
the key has yet to be found... With each 
door, a new possibility is revealed.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh...! Yes, destroy it! And 
demonstrate it! The pure ecstasy of 
destruction stripped of all reason!!

The store manager nods repeatedly at 
Tanino Gimlet's words. It looks like the 
makeover will go smoothly.

Maybe it's because I'm hesitating as I try 
to tear it, but it's just not working 
out...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, did fear still hold you back from 
acting on pure impulse?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“However, you have me standing before you. 
—If so, then...!”

Tanino Gimlet grabbed my hand, and ripped 
the clothes together with me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Think you're worthy now?

My clothes were ripped in a straight line. 
It was quite a bold tear—yet somehow, I 
felt it made them truly fitting to stand 
beside Tanino Gimlet.
